faq: Do I need analytics set up before the audit?
It helps, but it is not required. If you have Google Analytics or your platform reports, we read them. If you have nothing, we audit from what a shopper sees and tell you which tracking to add first.
Will you make the changes for me?
The audit is a written report only, so nothing on your store is changed. If you want us to build the fixes, we quote that as a separate order based on the list we send you.
Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Wix, Squarespace and most custom stores. We only need view access to the live store and, if you have it, read access to your analytics.
Is this the same as an SEO audit?
No. This audit looks at why visitors do not buy: trust, page layout, price clarity, checkout steps and mobile use. Search rankings are covered in our separate SEO audit.
